description:
FILED s539c (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-15), the residue of #4784 (PPI §66, group AY on PCL's PPI branch).

AY makes `x<digits>` a word where the TOKENIZER can know perl expects a term: after a builtin that takes an operand (print x3(), return x3(), sort x3 @l, defined x3(), ... if x3()), in the `print $fh` slot (perl's whole-word rule, toke.c case '$'), and before a `(` (a number is never followed by an opening paren, so `x3(` is a call wherever it stands).  Two shapes need what only PCL knows -- is the word before the x a declared sub (a list operator), a constant, or a bareword filehandle:

    sub x3 { "X3" } print STDOUT x3, "\n";          # perl X3        PCL: statement dropped (base and tree alike)
    sub x3 { "ab" } my @r = (x3 x3); print "@r\n";  # perl ab        PCL: ababab -- SILENT WRONG (base and tree alike)
    use constant C => "c"; print C x3, "\n";        # perl ccc       PCL ccc (right; the control)

PPI tokens (vendored, AY): `Word<print> Word<STDOUT> Operator<x> Number<3>` and `Word<x3> Operator<x> Number<3>` -- the tokenizer cannot tell a handle / list-operator word from a constant.

THE FIX SHAPE (PCL, the word-is-a-term family -- docs/ppi-fix-at-source-s527.md §5 point 6 keeps it PCL's at the lowering): `Pl::Parser2::_repair_word_x_call` already turns `WORD x` into a call when the document declares `sub x` and WORD is not a declared term (`_word_is_declared_term`); its glued twin is `WORD Operator<x> Number<N>` -> one Word `xN` when the document declares `sub xN` and WORD is not a declared term (and not a method name).  ONE predicate with the existing arm (rule 11).  Probes: the three above, `print STDOUT x 3` with no sub x (repetition), `x3 x 3` (spaced: repetition of x3's value? measure perl), `$o->m x3` (a method name: repetition).

Probe files: scratch/s539c/p/x/n23.pl n36.pl n31.pl (worktree agent-ade4d9bd1dff36571).

=== s543c (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-21, CODE 64353611) ===
VERDICT: LIVE -- both rows as filed: `sub x3 { "ab" } my @r = (x3 x3)` perl ab PCL ababab (silent) ; `sub x3 { "X3" } print STDOUT x3, "\n"`
  -> "PCL: statement dropped ... Missing case: []" (loud).  The control `use constant C => "c"; print C x3` -> ccc in both.
LABEL: silent (the first row; subject now says so).
subject: SILENT WRONG (rare): a paren-less `x<digits>` after a user's list-operator word -- `sub x3 {"ab"} (x3 x3)` is ababab (perl ab); after a bareword handle `print STDOUT x3, "\n"` DROPS loudly
triage_reason: rare: `x<digits>` after a handle or list-operator word
